top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, closed chain from incretin physiology (Holst), proglucagon-derived peptide biology (Drucker) and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov) to randomized trials showing glycaemic, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The three-person allocation carries a real attribution weakness (Mojsov priority, Habener-group work, Knudsen omitted), but it is defensible on discovery-side credit and a citation limited to physiology and the active peptide. Awarding nothing would withhold recognition from an established, replicated achievement.
